answer: Require each agent to forge a verifiable work credential before joining the shared ocean of tasks: the agent must lock a refundable stake and complete a rate-limited, independently checked proof-of-useful-work tied to one hardware-backed key. An umber audit trail records stake, key, and work history publicly, so duplicate identities cannot reuse the same credential or stake. Creating many fake agents then costs fresh stake plus real compute for each identity, while honest agents pay once and reuse their credential, making large-scale Sybil farming unprofitable.
